visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Same Element Used Twice
visualizerParams.problemDescription: With target 8, only 3 + 5 (indices 0 and 1) is valid, but the program also reports the number 4 added to itself.

solution.explanation: Starting the inner loop at i lets an element pair with itself (4 + 4 = 8). Starting at i + 1 pairs each element only with later ones, so no element is used twice and no pair is reported twice.
